segments.text: Okay so listen up because this part matters a lot.
The algorithm rewards watch time above everything else.
That means your first three seconds decide the whole video.
Start with motion, start with a question, never with a logo.
Then keep every single sentence under two seconds long.
Cut the pauses, cut the throat clearing, cut the intro.
People decide in half a second whether to keep watching.
Do that consistently and the reach takes care of itself.
